# Feature: Timer switch — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #25 (Timer switch) from Switches and Doors before it is used in real levels. Effect: door stays open for 5 seconds. Unique: the door window runs in real seconds after you leave. Useful: a sprint test between switch and door. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** door stays open for 5 seconds.

**So that** a sprint test between switch and door.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Timer switch for the first time in its teaching room (mech-25-timer-switch-room). Teaching moment: First room: a timer switch with its door at the far end of a short corridor and an orb on the way. A player who presses the switch and collects the orb on the way arrives as the countdown ends and the door closes, which teaches that the five seconds are spent by everything done inside them. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Pressing it opens its door and starts a visible 5-second countdown on the door
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: At zero the door closes
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Pressing again resets the countdown

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Timer switch's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-25-timer-switch-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/switches-and-doors.yml mechanic #25.
